join.function_edges: For every query link to model A, consumers of distinct model B where model Dice >=.65 and >=2 fields; require >=2 shared explicitly declared fields accessed as typed receiver attributes or supplied constructor keywords on both consumer functions, cosine >=.1, each function >=6lines, profile same-file rule. At most1 extra per query.
join.model_edges: Similar declared models from unchanged model pass. Model-only retrieves declarations linked to each batch query function. Joined uses exact same model pair union.
join.protection: Fund complete baseline function candidates in unchanged cosine descending and canonical pair ties before ANY model or linked function extras. Append all joined model candidates and at most1 function extra/query sorted by fixed evidence tuple. Baseline report displacement must be zero. No default-plus20 route.
join.ranking: Extras lexicographic descending shared used-field count, model Dice, function cosine; final kind and canonical pair identity ascending. Model extras use max supporting function evidence or (0,Dice,0) when absent. No score mixing, learned/judge/label/ID features.
join.resolution: Only explicit lexical declarations/import aliases/re-exports resolving uniquely to exact modules, parameter/local annotations, constructors, typed receiver self fields and return annotations. Reject ambiguous bindings, shadowed names and dynamic/star imports. No global name matching; retain unresolved sites. Shared model identity is delegation evidence, not an extra candidate.
